descriptionEn: Lamb, carrot, onion and rice cooked together in one pot. Central Asian comfort food.
descriptionZh: 羊肉、胡萝卜、洋葱与米饭同锅焖制。中亚的抚慰之食。

ingrZh: 2杯 长粒米，提前浸泡30分钟
stepsEn: Heat oil in a heavy pot (ideally a kazan) over high heat. Brown lamb pieces until deep golden. Remove.
In the same pot, fry onions until caramelized. Add carrots and cook until softened.
Return lamb. Add cumin, coriander, salt and enough boiling water to just cover. Simmer 40 min.
Drain rice and spread evenly over the meat and vegetables. Do not stir. Press the whole garlic head into the center.
Add boiling water to cover rice by 1cm. Cover tightly. Cook on low heat 25–30 min until rice has absorbed all liquid.
Remove garlic. Stir from the bottom to mix. Eat with your hands — that is the correct way.
stepsZh: 大火热油（最好用卡赞锅），将羊肉煎至深金黄色，取出备用。
同一口锅炒洋葱至焦糖化，加入胡萝卜翻炒至软。
放回羊肉，加孜然籽、香菜籽、盐和足量沸水刚好没过食材，小火焖煮40分钟。
沥干米，均匀铺在肉和蔬菜上方，不要翻搅，将整头大蒜插入中央。
加沸水至高出米面约1厘米，盖紧锅盖，小火焖25-30分钟至米饭吸干水分。
取出大蒜，从锅底翻拌均匀，用手抓着吃——这才是正确的方式。
details.notesEn: The layering is the technique — meat and vegetables on the bottom, rice on top, steam doing the work. The garlic becomes impossibly sweet and mild after steaming. The correct vessel is a kazan, but a Dutch oven works.
details.notesZh: 分层是关键技术——肉和蔬菜在下，米饭在上，靠蒸汽完成一切。大蒜经过蒸制后变得极度甘甜温和。正确的容器是卡赞锅，但铸铁锅也可以。
